name: alakazam_ml_v33
deployed_model: The frozen v32 657-feature Yushin recency LambdaRank remains deployed. The v33 OOF selector was evaluated leakage-free but did not clear its validation adoption gate.
model_scope: Exact Majkel memory, the v32 Yushin ranker, v29 fallback, and deterministic safety remain intact. Narrow v33 logic priorities own measured Run Away Draw, attacker rebuild, Poffin width, Enriching Energy cycle, and Froslass/Shaymin cases.

oof_selector.reason: Validation was 1.87 points below the frozen six-model reference; the selector is retained only as a shadow research artifact.

measured_logic_changes.p0_run_away_draw: Removed backup_eta<=1 and opponent-last-prize stops. Stop only for a completed same-turn KO, board-out risk, or deck survival.
measured_logic_changes.p1_rebuild_search: F/G states prioritize live Hilda, Dawn, Poke Pad, Run Away Draw, and body creation.
measured_logic_changes.p2_board_width: Poffin remains live through four core bodies and prioritizes a missing line or Dunsparce engine.
measured_logic_changes.p3_shaymin: Shaymin is not treated as protection while Froslass damage counters are live.
measured_logic_changes.enriching_energy: Removed the fixed Dudunsparce plus hand>=8 stop; exact-KO and deck guards remain.
measured_logic_changes.boss_engine_hunting: Inherited v25-v32 Froslass/Munkidori target logic unchanged.

safety_guards: Reject candidates that destroy a currently available KO.
Never end while the Active Alakazam can attack.
Never Run Away Draw from the only body.
Do not shrink a two-body board to one without an immediate replacement or payoff.
Require Run Away Draw to leave a normal next-turn deck draw.
Use v29/deterministic fallback for unsupported, nested, low-time, or illegal decisions.

promotion_decision.reason: The direct mirror A/B did not beat v31, while the target matchup A/B was tied. Real-ladder evidence is still required.

known_limitations: The requested 90% unseen Top-1 agreement was not reached.
The OOF base family used six deployable LightGBM variants; its 84.62% test oracle is less diverse than the prior eight-model neural/tree 91.68% oracle.
The existing Yushin test had already been observed during v32 research, so it is a development test rather than a pristine final holdout.
No newly acquired, completely unseen top-player holdout was available in this workspace.
Local A/B is small and uses the bundled simulator; it does not establish real-ladder superiority.
